Marsiva MR-UF800 800VA Offline UPS

The Marsiva MR-UF800 800VA Offline UPS provides reliable backup power for home and office electronics. With an 800VA capacity, it ensures uninterrupted power during outages, protecting devices like computers, routers, and appliances from voltage fluctuations, surges, and blackouts. Equipped with Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR), it stabilizes incoming voltage, providing consistent and safe power. The 12V/7Ah battery ensures long-lasting backup, while the fast recharge feature minimizes downtime. Ideal for users seeking an affordable yet efficient power protection solution, the Marsiva MR-UF800 is perfect for both residential and small business environments

Key Features of Marsiva MR-UF800 800VA Offline UPS:

800VA Capacity: Provides reliable power backup for home and office electronics, ensuring seamless operation during power outages.

Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR): Stabilizes incoming voltage, protecting sensitive equipment from power surges, fluctuations, and brownouts.

12V/7Ah Battery: Delivers long-lasting power backup, ensuring your devices remain powered during blackouts or voltage drops.

Simulated Sine Wave Output: Safe for devices like computers, routers, and other sensitive electronics.

Fast Recharge: The battery charges quickly, reducing downtime and ensuring your UPS is ready for the next power interruption.

Compact Design: Space-saving design that fits easily into home or office environments without taking up much room.

Overload & Short Circuit Protection: Built-in protections to safeguard against power surges and overloading, extending the life of the UPS and your devices.

LED Indicators: Easy-to-read indicators show operational status, including battery mode and overload warnings.

Audible Alarm System: Alerts you during power outages or when the battery is running low, ensuring you have enough time to shut down your devices safely.

User-Friendly Operation: Simple plug-and-play installation, making it easy to use for both beginners and experienced users.
